svg.title: High-reach demolition excavator — Niðurrifsgrafa
svg.desc: A tracked demolition carrier raises a steep multi-part boom and open jaws toward a partially standing wall.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-high-reach-demolition-excavator","label_en":"High-reach demolition excavator","label_is":"Niðurrifsgrafa","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["demolition","excavator"],"description":"A tracked demolition carrier raises a steep multi-part boom and open jaws toward a partially standing wall.","design_note":"Near-vertical boom, elevated shearing jaws and broken wall distinguish high-reach demolition from earth digging.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
